title: Tony Hawk's American Sk8land
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Score, combo, special meter
Vicarious Visions' GBA version of American Wasteland: isometric levels, score, combo, special meter

Flip, grab, grind, manual
Unlockable trick sets: lip transitions, grind transitions and flatland tricks

rows: rail balance, lip balance, manual balance and more, raised through play

widgets.text:
Story goals in each skate spot
Story goals given by skaters in each spot; some are combo or score targets, others item hunts

American skate spots
Skate spots across America in story order

Stat points and gear
Cheats unlock through play: always special, perfect balance modes, moon physics, jet pack, matrix, turbo and mini modes

Hidden items
Hidden skaters and cheats
Hidden skaters and cheats unlock as you finish goals

Story goals
Story goals per spot
Story goals per spot; finish all to move on
